//select: The page lists dozens of products. These rules pick the wanted six by what they ARE (LTV, term, fee saver vs standard) rather than by name, so a wording change on the page does not break the match. `ltv` at the top applies to every rule unless a rule overrides it. Run `python -m tracker discover` to see what each product on the page is classified as.
//order: This list is the display order: it drives the legend, the table columns and which colour each product gets. Standard 2/3/5 year, then Fee Saver 2/3/5 year. Reordering it repaints the chart, so change it deliberately rather than often.
//track_products: Escape hatch: exact scraped product ids to track instead of the rules above. Normally empty.

alert.//: Send a text when a tracked rate falls by at least this many percentage points versus its previous reading.

//selectors: Optional CSS selector overrides for the card parser, used only if the automatic strategies fail. See README.md.
